nfiles.description: The number of files to create in the benchmark directory.

avgfilesize.description: The average size in bytes of the files to be created.

stddevfilesize.description: The standard deviation in bytes of the file sizes. If 0, all files are avgfilesize.

percentro.description: The percentage of files that are read-only.

smallfiles.description: The percentage of files that are small (less than 1024 bytes) and appended to.

directory.description: The directory path where the Postmark benchmark will operate.

blocksize.description: The block size in bytes for I/O operations.

percentdelete.description: The percentage of operations that are deletes.

percentappend.description: The percentage of operations that are appends.

percentread.description: The percentage of operations that are reads.

percentcreate.description: The percentage of operations that are creates.

tasks.description: A list of command strings to run in the Postmark interactive shell. Each string typically contains parameters: nfiles avgfilesize stddev percentro smallfiles blocksize.
